data.description: Any creature that successfully ingests all or part of a Blighted Fey must make a Fortitude save with a DC of %1 or take 1 point of Str damage and 1 point of Dex damage. 1 minute later, the creature must save again or be nauseated 1 min and take 1d6 Str damage and 1d6 Dex damage.
